Context: Death while under suspension

## Death while under suspension  
Where a Government servant under suspension dies before the disciplinary proceedings or the court proceedings against him are concluded, the period between the date of suspension and the date of death shall be treated as duty for all purposes and his family shall be paid the full pay and allowances to which he wou.ld have been entitled had he not been suspended, for that period subject to adjustment of Subsistence Allowance already paid. - FR 54-B (2).
